propositions: Reconcile planning currently conflates snapshot reads, binding lifecycle decisions, and global mode caps without a pure, immutable plan value per ticket identity
Existing preview exposes mutations but not lifecycle effects that a live pass would execute, blocking safe retry recovery and global filtering
TicketPlan must contain mutations, lifecycle intents, dependencies, diagnostics, disposition, and observation/version identity computed before any I/O or remote effect
Selection, filtering, mode caps, and safety limits must run before lifecycle intent or remote operation eligibility to prevent out-of-order work
Inter-ticket dependencies (create-before-link, parent-before-child) must be explicit; blocked prerequisites yield deferred disposition rather than out-of-order mutations
Shadow mode with zero write authority allows side-by-side plan comparison against legacy differ output to detect unexplained behavioral divergence
